description: PREPRINT. ALL MAIN RESULTS ARE CONDITIONAL; NOT A CLAY MILLENNIUM PROBLEM CLAIM. Version 0.1.6 (this version's DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24148268; new version of 10.5281/zenodo.24122596; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24081999). Lean 4 (v4.30.0-rc1) / Mathlib (v4.30.0-rc1, rev 0c154d67103f74be3a0f2c509f72ccbf5be9f2a7). Pinned commit 4aba751d2d365faf0cc48c5b46e9aa0113519273 (main, 11 November 2026, merge of PR #5). WHAT IS NEW: the BKM continuation pillar is proved. FrohmanianTether.Pillars.periodicBKMContinuation_of_classical in FrohmanianTether/Pillars/BKMContinuation.lean shows that for every nu > 0, PeriodicBKMContinuation nu holds. The Main Theorem therefore needs only the still-open tether closing bound (as hard as Fefferman's statement (B)): clay_B_exact_of_periodic_tether_closing_bound (hclose : forall nu > 0, PeriodicTetherClosingBound nu) : Clay_B_exact, and clay_B_exact_unique_of_periodic_tether_closing_bound (same hypothesis; unique global velocity). This is not a proof of statement (B). The two-hypothesis form clay_B_exact_of_periodic_tether_bound remains, with hBKM now supplied by the pillar. SECOND THEOREM (unchanged, kernel-checked, periodicBKMIntegrability_of_periodicTetherBound): the tether bound at a datum implies Beale-Kato-Majda integrability there. The same commit includes PR #4: the repaired rate FeffermanClayA.FrohmanianTetherRateSmooth and the conditional reduction FeffermanClayA.clay_A_fefferman_of_frohmanianTetherRateSmooth of Fefferman's Problem (A). Both hypotheses of that theorem remain open for general data and are only shown satisfiable at u0 = 0. This is not a proof of Clay (A). The unrestricted FrohmanianTetherRate remains refuted (not_forall_frohmanianTetherRate). CORRECTIONS (0.1.5, with Lean proofs, module TetherDefinitionAudit): the sup-norm vorticity_sup_norm takes the junk value 0 on unbounded vorticity, so the 0.1.4 LocalTetherBound and LocalFiniteTimeVorticityBound imposed no constraint at such times (now guarded by BddAbove; the closing bound and frohmanian_tether_theorem range over data with bounded initial vorticity); and the 0.1.4 LocalTetherRate required two-sided differentiability of ||omega||_inf at the right endpoint: an explicit local solution from u0 = 0 with ||omega(t)||_inf = 1/t refutes it for every nu (not_forall_localTetherRateV014), so the 0.1.4 frohmanian_tether_theorem held vacuously. The corrected LocalTetherRate uses right derivatives and holds at zero data (localTetherRate_zero). Changed statements: LocalTetherBound, LocalFiniteTimeVorticityBound, LocalTetherRate, LocalTetherClosingBound, frohmanian_conditional_regularity_of_closing_bound, frohmanian_tether_theorem (exact diffs in the paper, Section 3.3). The library also formalizes the Frohmanian tether T(F,G) = -kappa ||omega||^2 int <Pi_u dF, Pi_u dG> on SDiff(T^3) (negative feedback (C3), transported (C1) under translations, canonicity in a restricted class, the corrected weight condition, an obstruction to damping) and the decaying shear and ABC flows as exact global periodic solutions for their own data. Open hypotheses, by Lean name: PeriodicTetherClosingBound / PeriodicTetherBound (the only remaining open hypothesis of the Main Theorem); KatoLocalWitness (hKato), BKMGlobalContinuation, SmoothPhysicalUniqueness, KatoUniquenessOnExistenceTimes, IsCoadjointMotion; LocalTetherRate, LocalTetherBound, LocalTetherClosingBound, PeriodicDirectionDepletionBound; the global-path forms FrohmanianTetherRate (refuted as a universal statement), FrohmanianTetherBound, FrohmanianTetherClosingBound, RiccatiMajorantExists; FrohmanianTetherRateSmooth and R3BKMContinuation for general data; kernel-class conditions on a competitor B; and (C2) for T at regular vorticities. Build: 8389 jobs; 1886 theorem constants (1674 stated in the sources, 212 auto-generated) and 2546 declarations in 42 FrohmanianTether.* and 52 vendored BKMPillar.* modules audited; no sorry, no native_decide, no axiom declarations; only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound (enforced in CI). Verified commit 4aba751d2d365faf0cc48c5b46e9aa0113519273; reproduce from a fresh clone with: bash scripts/verify.sh. Not a proof of Navier-Stokes global regularity; no Clay Millennium claim.
